# Pixvael

Image to pixel art converter. Free, private, runs entirely in the browser.

## Pages
- / : Image to pixel art (main converter)
- /image-to-pixel-art : in-depth guide for the image to pixel art converter
- /pixel-art-converter : universal converter preset for any image format
- /jpg-to-pixel-art : JPG photo to pixel art converter
- /png-to-pixel-art : PNG to pixel art with transparency intact (logos, sprites)
- /webp-to-pixel-art : WebP to pixel art converter with PNG export
- /photo-to-pixel-art : photo to pixel art with subject-specific block sizes
- /picture-to-pixel-art : picture to pixel art converter (any source)
- /minecraft-pixel-art : section-based build planner with progress tracking
- /image-to-minecraft-pixel-art : fast image-to-block conversion workflow
- /minecraft-pixel-art-generator : generate a Minecraft block plan from any image
- /minecraft-pixel-art-maker : editable block painter with undo, redo, and restore
- /minecraft-pixel-art-converter : side-by-side 24/32/48/64 block comparison
- /tutorials : Minecraft pixel art tutorial directory
- /tutorials/how-to-make-pixel-art-in-minecraft : beginner build guide, manual and generator methods
- /tutorials/minecraft-image-to-pixel-art-guide : complete image-to-blocks conversion walkthrough

## About
Pixvael converts images to pixel art using Canvas color quantization:
downsample each block of pixels into one color, optionally map to a limited
palette (Game Boy 4-color, 8-bit PICO-8, or full color), with optional
Floyd-Steinberg dithering. Pure frontend, no AI API, no image upload —
photos never leave the user's device.

## Use cases
Minecraft pixel art, avatars, wallpapers, perler bead patterns, game sprites,
posters and prints.

## Minecraft outputs
The generator converts an image to an editable 52-block grid (wool, terracotta,
concrete, stone, sandstone, deepslate; filterable by game version 1.9-1.21+).
Exports: pixel PNG, coordinate blueprint PNG, per-zone blueprint, material CSV,
and a classic .schematic file (gzip NBT) with vertical mural or flat map-art
orientation for WorldEdit / Litematica import. Projects save to a JSON file and
reopen with edits and build progress intact. All build progress and maker edits
are stored locally in the browser.
